# Learnings and mistakes

No structural facts are generated for this page; the store has no concept of a mistake, only of records, decisions and handovers. Everything here is written by hand.

## Notes (human, preserved verbatim on regeneration)

<!-- bm-human:begin -->
MISTAKE, the expensive one: the first board rebuild kept the design and
lost the structure, second violation of the founder's progress-page
expectations, scored 1 of 5. The structure is now an ABSOLUTE order in
the global CLAUDE.md and decision D7. The lesson is not the structure
itself but the class: when the founder attaches reference images, the
deliverable follows them literally, and a diff against the reference
comes before publishing.

LEARNING: the fence hook derives its own session id (bm1- prefix hash),
not the harness uuid. Claim fences with the hook's id or it blocks its
own owner. Cost one adopt-and-reclaim cycle.

LEARNING: the full gate REFUSES a dirty tracked tree by design (it reads
uncommitted edits as suite contamination). The order is: commit with
checksums last, then gate the SHA, then push. First gate attempt burned
ten minutes learning this.

LEARNING: two fence systems disagreed (store fence allowed README, a dead
session's SBE prose fence in STATE.md blocked it). Live evidence for
R1.5, prose fence retirement.

NEAR MISS: a researcher's final message lost its report tables
(truncation); a SendMessage asking for a compact re-emit recovered it
cheaply. Watch subagent finals for meta text replacing content.

NEAR MISS: the adversarial review caught the board authorizing the tag as
an agent step (F2) and done-checks naming files that do not exist (F1)
before anything shipped. The refute pass earns its cost.
